name: Organizely
long_description:
Organizely helps American manufacturers use AI to lower production costs. 

Factories depend on three resources: materials, equipment, and labor. Costs rise unexpectedly when components are missing, machines go down, or staffing doesn’t match demand. We experienced this firsthand while owning and operating a factory in the U.S. for six years. As we scaled, it was expensive to resolve factory-wide bottlenecks quickly and it became harder to stay competitive on price. 

Other companies are trying to layer AI agents on top of legacy ERPs to do logistics work, but the underlying data architectures limit how much those agents can understand and do. So we’re building a new ERP from the ground up for the era of AI. 

Organizely is an AI-native ERP with AI reasoning and machine learning algorithms embedded throughout for a single intelligent platform that can model, predict, and act. We natively automate all core manufacturing workflows including demand planning, raw material tracking, machine maintenance, and production scheduling. 

Organizely continuously improves over time, suggesting new ways for manufacturers to reduce costs and produce more with their existing facilities and teams. It's the whole factory solved. 

We’ve deployed to factories across six U.S. states and now we’re bringing AI to all factories across America. 🇺🇸

launches.body:
**Organizely is a vertically-integrated, AI-native ERP that models factory operations, predicts bottlenecks, and takes action to lower production costs.** 

**If you're a manufacturer and you want to get more out of your existing facility and team, reach out to us at [founders@organizely.io](mailto:founders@organizely.io).** 

🎬 **Launch Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRI5Wm_7x20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRI5Wm_7x20)**

➡️ **Our Origin Story** 

In 2020, we founded our first company called Kinetic Labs, a custom mechanical keyboard factory in New Jersey that has served over 100,000+ customers. **We quickly learned that materials, equipment, and labor all have to be coordinated in sync to avoid expensive cost overruns.** 

One seemingly small logistics mistake would compound into a margin-killer when it led to missing materials, offline equipment, overstaffed schedules, or cancelled orders. The best way to **lower production costs, protect margins, and stay competitive as a U.S. manufacturer** was by leveraging AI to plan our resources more efficiently. 

➡️ **What's Not Working for Manufacturers**

Legacy ERP systems only record problems after they happen. Other companies are trying to layer AI agents on top of legacy ERPs to automate logistics work, but the underlying data architecture limit how much those agents can understand and do. 

➡️ **Our Solution & Technology**

With 10+ years of experience as professional software engineers and 6+ years growing a factory, we decided to completely reimagine ERPs from the ground up for the era of AI. 

**Organizely is an AI-native ERP that uses AI reasoning and machine learning embedded throughout for a single intelligent platform that can model, predict, and act.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126862&key=user_uploads/2969147/c8affe38-61d2-4389-bac9-c934745c102c)

_Image Caption: Live 3D model of a Factory Floor_  

We built Organizely on a foundation of manufacturing logic to **natively automate all core manufacturing workflows** including demand planning, raw material tracking, machine maintenance, and production scheduling. 

We collect real-time data from multimodal inputs across your factory into a single platform, and then build highly customizable applications for **specialized manufacturing workflows**.

Organizely **continuously improves over time**, suggesting new ways for manufacturers to reduce costs and produce more with their existing facilities and teams. 

**It's the whole factory solved.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126862&key=user_uploads/2969147/9ebd6bd1-d289-4f06-8c6c-38d8616ee988)

_Image Caption: AI-powered end-to-end Material Traceability_ 

➡️ **Our Mission** 

Factories make America strong, so we’re making the factories strong. 

We’ve deployed Organizely to factories across six U.S. states, and now we’re bringing AI to all factories across America. 

If you’re a manufacturer and you want to get more out of your existing team and facility, reach out to us. **Let’s build the future of American manufacturing together.** 🇺🇸

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=126862&key=user_uploads/2969147/36452d4e-b48b-41b0-9ddf-efea446893c4)
